title: Your First Weekend at Colorado State University-Fort Collins, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In Day Check-In
cards.subtitle: The start of your Ram journey
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned hall during your scheduled time slot to collect your keys and start settling into your new home.
cards.short_summary: Official move-in process for new students living on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in for residence halls typically occurs on the Tuesday and Wednesday before classes begin.
cards.source_title: Move In Information - Housing & Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Requires a pre-registered arrival time slot via the CSU Housing Portal.

cards.title: Ram Welcome Carnival
cards.subtitle: Thursday night festivities
cards.notes: Head to the LSC West Lawn for a night of games, food, and music to celebrate your first week on campus.
cards.short_summary: An evening social event featuring carnival games and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ram Welcome Carnival is a scheduled evening event for all new students on the Thursday of orientation week.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Ram Welcome Full Schedule
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students; typically runs from 6:00 PM to 10:30 PM.

cards.title: Night @ the Rec
cards.subtitle: Late-night fitness and fun
cards.notes: Explore the climbing wall, pool, and courts during this special late-night event designed for new students.
cards.short_summary: A late-night open house at the campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Night @ the Rec is a signature Ram Welcome event held at the Student Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Late-night access provided specifically for orientation participants; RamCard required.

cards.title: University Convocation
cards.subtitle: The official academic kickoff
cards.notes: Join your classmates for the formal ceremony that marks the beginning of your academic career at CSU.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony welcoming the new class to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation is a required ceremony for first-year students held at Moby Arena on Friday morning.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; clear bag policy is enforced at Moby Arena.

cards.title: Hike to the 'A'
cards.subtitle: A historic mountain tradition
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to the foothills and hike up to the iconic 'A' to learn about CSU's Aggie heritage.
cards.short_summary: A guided hike to the hillside 'A' landmark overlooking Fort Collins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hike to the A is an interest program offered during Ram Welcome for incoming students.
cards.source_title: CSU prepares for another year of traditions with Ram Welcome's annual Hike to The A
cards.access_notes: Bus pickup is typically at the Alumni Center; registration may be required.

cards.title: Libraries Welcome Back
cards.subtitle: Explore your study hub
cards.notes: Stop by the lobby for snacks, games, and to learn about research resources and printing services.
cards.short_summary: An open house event at the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morgan Library hosts a 'Welcome Back' event with snacks and games during the first week of classes.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; RamCard required for entry after 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Plaza Welcome Days
cards.subtitle: The heart of campus life
cards.notes: Visit the central plaza for free ice cream, photo booths, and information from various campus organizations.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day resource fair held in the main campus plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Plaza Welcome Days occur from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM during the first week of the fall semester.
cards.source_title: First 50 Days - Orientation and Transition Programs
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; events typically run midday.

cards.title: Afternoon Garden Walk
cards.subtitle: A quiet campus escape
cards.notes: Walk through nearly three acres of vibrant blooms used for horticultural research and public enjoyment.
cards.short_summary: A public research garden featuring over 1,000 varieties of annuals.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSU Annual Flower Trial Gardens are open daily to the public free of charge during daylight hours.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during daylight hours; located across from the University Center for the Arts.

cards.title: Explore Old Town
cards.subtitle: Beyond the campus gates
cards.notes: Take the MAX bus to downtown Fort Collins to browse local shops and enjoy lunch with new friends.
cards.short_summary: A trip to the historic downtown district of Fort Collins.
cards.evidence_claim: Ram Welcome includes scheduled times for students to explore Old Town Fort Collins, often via the MAX bus.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the MAX bus; students often meet Ram Welcome Leaders for guided trips.

cards.title: Walk the Historic Oval
cards.subtitle: The heart of the university
cards.notes: Stroll under the century-old elm trees in the most historic and picturesque part of the CSU campus.
cards.short_summary: The historic central green space of the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oval was designed in 1909 and serves as the aesthetic heart of the Colorado State University campus.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space available 24/7; central to many campus buildings.
